notes.title: Update 0.8.0.5

notes.title: Minor Update 0.8.0.1 – Quality of Life Improvements
notes.content: [h2]Hello Anomaly Observers,[/h2][p]We’re rolling out a small update to improve your anomaly-hunting experience:[/p][list][*][p]Reports now apply to the original room where they were submitted, preventing failures caused by camera shifts.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now freely move the camera while submitting a report.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the size of the Office Chair in the Living Room in House Contract for better visual consistency.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for playing and keep those anomalies in check![/p]

notes.title: Anomaly Observer has been released!
notes.content: [h1]Welcome, Anomaly Observer.[/h1][p]Step into the unsettling world of [i]Anomaly Observer[/i], a psychological horror game where observation is your only weapon. Spot the differences in eerie environments, uncover hidden anomalies, and survive the creeping dread that lurks in every corner.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Atmospheric tension and immersive visuals[/i] [i]designed to challenge your perception and nerves[/i][/p][p]Whether you're a fan of slow-burn horror or just love testing your attention to detail, [i]Anomaly Observer[/i] is ready to mess with your mind.[/p][p][b]Available now on Steam[/b][/p][p]Let the observation begin…[/p]

notes.title: An Important Update on Anomaly Observer
notes.content: [p]Hello Anomaly Observers,[/p][p]We’ve got a major update to share regarding the release of [i]Anomaly Observer[/i]. After much reflection and discussion within our team, we’ve decided to [b]shift our release strategy[/b]: instead of launching the full version, we will be releasing the game in [b]Early Access[/b].[/p][p][/p][h3]Why the Change?[/h3][p]Our vision for [i]Anomaly Observer[/i] has evolved. While the game is already fully playable and offers a compelling experience, we believe that involving the community earlier will help us take it even further. Early Access allows us to:[/p][list][*][p]Gather feedback from real players[/p][/*][*][p]Improve gameplay balance and polish[/p][/*][*][p]Add new content based on your suggestions[/p][/*][*][p]Build a stronger, more connected community[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]What to Expect in Early Access[/h3][p]The Early Access version will include:[/p][list][*][p]The full core gameplay experience[/p][/*][*][p]All contracts[/p][/*][*][p]All major features already implemented[/p][/*][/list][p]However, there may still be bugs, and some areas will benefit from refinement. We’ll be actively updating the game based on your feedback.[/p][p][/p][h3]What Comes Next?[/h3][p]We plan to stay in Early Access for approximately [b]6 months[/b], during which we’ll:[/p][list][*][p]Add new content and features[/p][/*][*][p]Polish visuals and performance[/p][/*][*][p]Improve localization and accessibility[/p][/*][*][p]Respond to community feedback[/p][/*][/list][p]Once we feel the game has reached its full potential, we’ll launch version 1.0 with a price increase to reflect the added value.[/p][p][/p][h3]Join Us on This Journey[/h3][p]We’re incredibly excited to open the doors to [i]Anomaly Observer[/i] and invite you to be part of its evolution. Your feedback will shape the future of the game, and we can’t wait to hear what you think.[/p][p]Thank you for your support—and welcome to the anomaly.[/p]

notes.title: Anomaly Observer Officially Launches August 19, 2025
notes.content: [h2]Get ready to dive into a world unlike any other.[/h2][p]We’re thrilled to announce that [i][b]Anomaly Observer[/b][/i], our passion-fueled observation game, will officially release on [b]August 19, 2025[/b]. Step into a hauntingly atmospheric realm where mystery, science fiction, and psychological tension collide.[/p][p][/p][p]This release marks a major milestone in our journey, and we can’t wait for you to uncover the anomalies waiting beneath the surface.[/p][p]Stay tuned, follow us on Steam, and prepare to observe the unexpected.[/p][p][b][u]Wishlist [i]Anomaly Observer[/i][/u][/b][u] [b]now[/b][/u] and be among the first to enter its unsettling dimension[/p][p][/p][p]Get ready to experience our vision of a perfect observation duty game in one of 5 Contracts, for just [b]9.99$ [/b]with launch discount! ([b]11.99$[/b] [b]after 14 days[/b]).[/p]
